channel.title: Sam Wong | Co-Founder & AI Train-the-Trainer
channel.description: AI adoption insights, workshop reflections, and practical AI training tips from Sam Wong.

item.title: 香港企業採購 AI 培訓前，必問供應商的五條問題
item.description: 每間供應商網站的字眼幾乎一樣：practical、hands-on、度身訂造。這份清單幫你在表面相似的說法之間做分辨——而寫這份清單的人，自己就是供應商，每條問題你都可以拿回來問我。

item.title: 香港 AI Train-the-Trainer 課程：你買的是什麼？付款前必問的五條問題
item.description: 你買的從來不是 AI 知識，而是一套交付系統：可修改的教材、run-of-show、hands-on 帶法、現場出事的應變、證書之後的工作機會——付款前要問的五條問題。

item.title: Five Questions to Ask Before You Buy Corporate AI Training in Hong Kong
item.description: Every provider page says the same things: practical, hands-on, tailored. Five questions that tell them apart -- from someone who sells this, so use the questions against me too.

item.title: How to Choose an AI Train-the-Trainer Program in Hong Kong
item.description: Hong Kong is short of people who can deliver AI training properly. What a train-the-trainer program should hand you, the five questions to ask before you pay, and where I stand as someone who runs one.

item.title: I've Written Down 103 Rules for My AI. Three of Them Broke Last Week.
item.description: I published the guide to building a four-tier AI memory system. Then I spent three weeks grading my own. Three rules broke that were already written down -- and none of them failed because the system couldn't find the rule.

item.title: 懂 AI 和用 AI，是兩件事
item.description: 一次性的工作坊過後，大約只有 4% 的人會把 AI 真正用下去，九成六兩星期內打回原形。問題不在工具，而在習慣——真正的改變，是一件小事重複很多次。

item.title: Why My AI Wrote Badly in Three Languages (It Wasn't the Model)
item.description: I asked my AI assistant why its writing is bad in English, Chinese and French. The answer wasn't the model -- it was the templates I fed it months ago, when the models were weaker. We deleted eight of them this week.

item.title: 我問 AI 為甚麼文筆這麼差——答案不是模型
item.description: 問題不在模型，在幾個月前寫下的舊指令：模型每一次升級都更強，舊模板卻一直把文字拉回 2025 年的水平。這星期刪掉了八個問題來源，這篇文章就是第一個測試。

item.title: Three US Businesses, One Hong Kong Trainer
item.description: Between April and June 2026, I ran three remote AI coaching sessions for US businesses -- a realty firm, a skincare founder, and an equipment dealer. Here's what makes a single-session coaching call produce something worth the time.

item.title: 三間美國公司，一個香港 AI 教練：遙距一對一怎樣才有用
item.description: 2026 年 4 至 6 月，三節來自美國的單次 AI coaching call——沒有課程、沒有後續合約，有用的原因是同一個三步結構：call 前拿到真實任務、工具配對任務、一起做出一個 output。

item.title: Why My Best AI Workshops Have Thirteen People, Not Five Hundred
item.description: The industry counts reach. But the AI training sessions where workflow actually changes have thirteen people in them, every screen visible, every problem solved in real time.

item.title: 為什麼我最好的 AI 工作坊是十三個人，不是五百人
item.description: 十三人的房間為什麼比五百人的 webinar 更能改變 workflow：三個具體機制——每個螢幕都看得見、session 可以為一個人停、參加者用自己的材料——加上一個講清楚的代價。

item.title: One Jewellery Brand, Two AI Trainings in Two Days: Design, Then Operations
item.description: A Hong Kong jewellery retailer booked one AI session for its design team, then booked a second for operations the next day. What the two curricula looked like, and what cross-department demand actually signals.

item.title: What a 500-Person AI Webinar Can and Can't Do
item.description: I delivered a firmwide AI awareness webinar for a global advertising group in Hong Kong. About 500 people. Here's what a broadcast that size can realistically do, what it can't, and the three design choices that make it worth running.

item.title: 180 People, Six Sessions, One Pattern
item.description: Across six different AI sessions and 180 participants at one organisation, the pattern was consistent -- the executives were more anxious than their staff. What this means for who you train first.

item.title: What 120 CEOs Asked After the AI Demo
item.description: At the YPO AI Advantage Summit in Los Angeles, 120 CEOs asked questions that had nothing to do with AI. They asked about creativity, their children, and whether they'd started too late. Here are the answers.

item.title: 為 120 位 CEO 示範 AI 之後，他們問的問題與 AI 無關
item.description: 2025 年 11 月，洛杉磯 YPO 峰會上，120 位 CEO 在 AI 示範後提出的問題涉及創意、子女出路與起步時機，而非技術本身。本文整理這些問題的答案。

item.title: A Year of AI Training at a Hong Kong Food Company: Six Departments, Twenty Sessions
item.description: What happens when a company doesn't just book one AI workshop, but keeps going -- department by department -- for a full year.

item.title: 一間香港食品公司的一年 AI 培訓：六個部門，二十節課
item.description: 從一場標準 AI 工作坊開始，該公司六個部門在一年內上了約二十節課，超過一百名員工受訓，5 月評估達 4.48 分。

item.title: Five Things Every AI Trainer Should Prepare -- and the One That Saves You
item.description: After enough broken demos and quiet rooms, the preparation for any AI training engagement crystallized into five outputs. Here's what they are.

item.title: Two Workshops, One Day: Parents in the Morning, Kids in the Afternoon
item.description: A parent workshop about AI fears at a Hong Kong school in the morning. A children's AI build in the afternoon. Same tools, same city, and the working answers I've started giving parents since.

item.title: 同一日兩場 AI 工作坊：上午教家長，下午教小朋友
item.description: 同一日，上午我在香港一間中學向約一百位家長講 AI，下午二十個孩子用 AI 生成海報；本文是我實際給家長的答案。

item.title: What SMEs Actually Ask About AI
item.description: I sat on a panel at an HKPC expo for small businesses. The prepared answers were fine. The audience's questions were better — here are the actual answers.

item.title: The architect that never writes code
item.description: Companion take to the build log: the most expensive model in the stack wrote zero implementation code. Four bugs died at the spec stage, three workers passed the same five gates, and the blind pick landed on the cheapest. The pattern, not the model, is the asset.

item.title: 從不寫 code 的 architect model
item.description: 一個從不寫 code 的 architect 模型，統籌 3 個來自不同公司的模型在同一條 git branch 上工作，在 spec 階段就消滅了 4 個 bug，最終產出一份淨刪減的 diff。模型是可以互換的應徵者——orchestration 才是資產。

item.title: Three models, one branch, zero deployment
item.description: First live run of the architect pattern on my own website: Claude Fable 5 wrote the specs and verdicts, Grok 4.5 and GPT-5.5 did the typing in parallel. 75 files, +167/−668 — and nothing ships until I decide.

item.title: AI made me a manager, not a better maker
item.description: AI raised my output and quietly changed the job — from making the thing to deciding what is worth making. Five practitioners circling the same shift, and why taste is the part that did not get automated.

item.title: Three Gemini Tools Collapsed Into One Prompt Today
item.description: Google shipped Gemini Omni at I/O 2026 — Veo, Nano Banana, and Genie folded into one multimodal prompt surface. Three of my daily Gemini calls collapse into one. Day one read, API still weeks out, the consolidation thesis lands.

item.title: 三個 Gemini 工具，今日合併成一個 prompt
item.description: Google 今早在 I/O 2026 發佈 Gemini Omni，把 Veo、Nano Banana 與 Genie 摺進同一個 prompt surface——Sam 日常的三條 Gemini call 收歸一個。未實測，但方向值得 day one 寫下：跨輪持久性仍是關鍵死穴。

item.title: Plus, Minus, Multiply, Divide: A Cheat Sheet for Teaching Copilot
item.description: I rewrote a finance Copilot workshop at 1am and reorganised it around four arithmetic moves. The framework outlasted the panic.

item.title: 加、減、乘、除：教 Copilot 的速查表
item.description: 凌晨 1 點推倒財務工作坊教材，圍繞加減乘除四則運算重新設計。與其教功能導覽，不如給一套記得住的方法論：加 context，減雜訊，用 agent 重複好動作，用 custom instructions 省掉時間稅。3 星期後的星期二，才是真正的測試。

item.title: How to Prep for a Job Interview Using AI in 30 Minutes
item.description: A 30-minute AI loop for prepping a job interview — NotebookLM podcasts of your CV, then the company, then a recorded ChatGPT voice-mode mock interview.

item.title: 用 AI 30 分鐘準備求職面試
item.description: 用 NotebookLM 生成 podcast、ChatGPT 語音模擬面試，再把錄音掉回 notebook——3 個 source 疊加，循環 2 至 3 輪，30 分鐘一圈，讓大腦在面試的語言裡浸到熟悉。不是背答案，是高速建立接觸效應。

item.title: I've Now Run AI Workshops for the Same Company Three Times. The Third Batch Is Nothing Like the First.
item.description: I've been training at a Hong Kong food manufacturer since January: HR, then Sales & Marketing, now Operations. The third batch required a 120-row fake production dataset and 26 new prompts. Nothing from Batch 1 transferred.

item.title: 三輪 AI 工作坊，同一間公司——第三輪我一張舊 slide 都沒用
item.description: 1 月起在一間香港食品製造商培訓：HR、市場及銷售，現在是營運。第三輪他放棄全部舊 slide，從零建 120 行虛構生產數據集和 26 條專用 prompt，並坦言未知成效。一間機構的 AI 成熟度不是一個分數，是一幅拼布。

item.title: Why Hong Kong's AI Disadvantage Is Actually an Advantage
item.description: I trained 120 CEOs in LA who couldn't copy and paste. Hong Kong's tech literacy is higher than people think. The real gap isn't VPNs — it's information lag and the Cantonese blind spot.

item.title: What Happens When a School Commits to 24 Months of AI Training
item.description: Last April I trained 400 educators in 75 minutes. Then HKCT came back for a 24-month AI Learning Community — and mandated NotebookLM for all students and staff by September.

item.title: I Audited My AI-Managed Blog. Half the Posts Were Slop.
item.description: I teach people to evaluate AI output critically. Then I read my own blog and found five posts with the same three-point structure, the same filler transitions, and the same closing. Here is what I changed.

item.title: My Blog Publishes Itself. It Died Silent for 3 Weeks.
item.description: I built an autonomous AI blog pipeline. It ran for months, published 47 posts, then silently stopped for three weeks. Exit code 0. No alerts. Here is what went wrong and the three principles I now follow.

item.title: 我的部落格自動發佈文章。然後悄無聲息地停擺了三星期。
item.description: 我建立了一條自動化 AI 內容管線。運行數月，發佈了 47 篇文章，然後悄然停擺三週。退出碼 0。無警報。以下是出了什麼問題，以及我現在遵循的三個原則。

item.title: 9% of Copilot Licenses Are Actually Used. I'm Not Surprised.
item.description: Organizations spend millions on AI licenses and zero on training. The adoption gap isn't a tool problem -- it's a training problem wearing a tool costume.

item.title: 9% 的 Copilot 授權有人使用。我一點也不意外
item.description: Copilot 授權只有 9% 曾被啟用，與一次性培訓後僅 4% 持續使用的數字指向同一問題：企業把 99% 預算用來買工具，1% 用來教人。真正留得住的採用，靠的是培訓完結之後仍然有人在。

item.title: I Built an AI Chatbot in 2 Weeks. Here's What Broke on Turn 3.
item.description: The gap between 'build an AI chatbot' tutorials and a working production chatbot is measured in crashes, security holes, and spec rewrites.

item.title: 兩星期建了一個 AI Chatbot。第三輪對話就崩潰
item.description: 一個人加一隊 AI coding agent，兩星期建好涵蓋 137 間學校的 multi-agent chatbot，卻在第三輪對話死掉。原因是一條檢查組裝 context 而非用戶訊息的 guardrail——修復只需 6 行 code，找到它用了 1 小時。

item.title: Claude Code Mastery: The Full Blueprint — My Actual System

item.title: Claude Code Mastery: Agent Teams & Automation — Your AI Workforce
item.description: I have 9 AI agents running 7 cron jobs. My blog publishes itself every Monday. Here is the full agent team architecture — delegation rules, parallel execution, and cost-aware model selection.

item.description: 9 個 agent、7 個 cron job：blog 每星期一自動發文，每個平日 8:30 收到廣東話簡報。這篇拆解單一 agent 為何會崩、平行與順序執行怎樣選，以及讓 9 個 agent 不燒錢的模型路由。

item.title: Claude Code Mastery: Hooks & Guardrails — Making AI Safe

item.title: Claude Code Mastery: Skills & Memory — Teaching AI to Remember

item.description: 花 45 分鐘教會 AI，第二天它全忘掉——Sam 稱之為金魚問題。他建了四層記憶系統加 40 個按需載入的 skill，開機載入不超過 5,000 token，讓 AI 運作得像一個共事了幾個月的同事。
